notes: GrounDiff conditioned on the lasground_new result: predicts the EA hand-edited DTM. Extra inputs follow ALS2DTM/DeepTerRa (Le et al. 2022): lowest-return rasters, statistic rasters (density, z_std, echoes) and the 2-channel ground/non-ground raster (their 'sem2'), here built from lasground_new classes; the lasground_new DTM is an input channel and the PrioStitch-style prior.
